svg.title: Only the latest — execution at step 39, 220 ms
svg.desc: A fixed pipeline graph and four synchronized lanes: time, source notifications, internal reactions, and resulting notifications. Dashed glyphs identify modelled explanations; solid glyphs identify observed events. Events at one time retain their sequence order. Subscription endings distinguish completion from cancellation.

g.aria-label: Inspect Cold source. A at 0, B at 20, C at 80; complete at 140 ms. One subscription.. unsubscribe · complete. Values enter here
g.title: Cold source: A at 0, B at 20, C at 80; complete at 140 ms. One subscription.

g.aria-label: Inspect debounceTime(40). Keep the latest value until 40 ms of silence. The deadline shown is a teaching model, not an inspected timer handle.. unsubscribe · complete. pending=null · deadline=null
g.title: debounceTime(40): Keep the latest value until 40 ms of silence. The deadline shown is a teaching model, not an inspected timer handle.

g.aria-label: Inspect switchMap(result). Only the latest inner subscription remains active. Each cold inner emits its value after 100 ms.. unsubscribe · complete. activeInner=null · outerComplete=true
g.title: switchMap(result): Only the latest inner subscription remains active. Each cold inner emits its value after 100 ms.

g.aria-label: Inspect Observer. Receives only C at 220 ms, then Complete. B is cancelled at 120, not when C first arrives at 80.. unsubscribe · complete. Subscriber receives
g.title: Observer: Receives only C at 220 ms, then Complete. B is cancelled at 120, not when C first arrives at 80.
